points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 弗洛伊德于1856年5月6日出生在摩拉维亚的弗赖贝格（现属捷克共和国），原名西吉斯蒙德·施洛姆·弗洛伊德。他的父亲雅各布是一位羊毛商人，母亲阿玛莉亚是父亲的第三任妻子，比父亲小20岁。弗洛伊德是八个孩子中的长子，但父亲前两次婚姻已有两个儿子，因此弗洛伊德实际上有三个同父异母的哥哥。这段复杂的家庭关系对弗洛伊德后来的心理发展理论产生了深远影响，尤其是他对俄狄浦斯情结的思考。
points.descriptionEn: Freud was born on May 6, 1856, in Freiberg, Moravia (now Příbor, Czech Republic), to Jewish wool merchant Jacob Freud and his third wife Amalia. As the first of eight children, Freud had three older half-brothers from his father's previous marriages. This complex family dynamic profoundly influenced his later theories on psychological development, particularly his formulation of the Oedipus complex.

points.title: 求学岁月
points.description: 1860年，弗洛伊德全家迁往维也纳。他在这里接受了严格的教育，展现出卓越的学术才能。1873年，他以优异成绩进入维也纳大学医学院。在大学期间，他受到生理学家恩斯特·布吕克的影响，对神经系统研究产生浓厚兴趣。同时，他也广泛涉猎哲学，特别是尼采和叔本华的著作，这些思想后来融入他的精神分析理论。弗洛伊德在大学期间还结识了后来成为精神分析学派重要成员的威廉·弗利斯，两人保持了多年的学术交流。
points.descriptionEn: In 1860, Freud's family moved to Vienna, where he received a rigorous education and demonstrated exceptional academic abilities. In 1873, he entered the University of Vienna Medical School with outstanding grades. Influenced by physiologist Ernst Brücke, Freud developed a keen interest in nervous system research. He also extensively studied philosophy, particularly the works of Nietzsche and Schopenhauer, which later integrated into his psychoanalytic theories. During his university years, Freud met Wilhelm Fliess, who would become an important figure in the psychoanalytic movement.

points.title: 巴黎深造
points.description: 1885年，弗洛伊德获得一笔研究资助，前往巴黎跟随著名神经学家让-马丁·沙尔科学习。沙尔科在巴黎萨尔佩特里埃医院对歇斯底里症的研究给弗洛伊德留下了深刻印象。他观察到沙尔科通过催眠治疗神经症患者，并发现这些症状可能源于心理因素而非生理原因。这段经历对弗洛伊德转向心理治疗产生了决定性影响。1886年，弗洛伊德回到维也纳，开始将催眠技术应用于自己的临床实践，并逐渐发展出更为系统的治疗方法。
points.descriptionEn: In 1885, Freud received a research grant to study in Paris with renowned neurologist Jean-Martin Charcot at the Salpêtrière Hospital. Charcot's work on hysteria profoundly impressed Freud, who observed him treating neurotic patients through hypnosis and discovering that symptoms might stem from psychological rather than physiological causes. This experience decisively influenced Freud's shift toward psychotherapy. Upon returning to Vienna in 1886, Freud began applying hypnotic techniques in his clinical practice, gradually developing more systematic therapeutic methods.

points.title: 精神分析创立
points.description: 1886年，弗洛伊德在维也纳开设了自己的诊所，专门治疗神经和精神疾病。1895年，他与约瑟夫·布罗伊尔合作出版《歇斯底里研究》，首次提出心理创伤可能导致神经症状的理论。1900年，弗洛伊德出版《梦的解析》，标志着精神分析理论的正式诞生。1902年，他开始与一群志同道合的医生定期聚会，逐渐形成了精神分析学派。1908年，第一届国际精神分析大会在萨尔茨堡召开。1910年，国际精神分析协会成立，弗洛伊德担任主席。这一时期，弗洛伊德发展了关于潜意识、防御机制、性心理发展阶段等核心理论，并培养了包括卡尔·荣格、阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒在内的一批重要追随者。
points.descriptionEn: In 1886, Freud opened his private practice in Vienna specializing in nervous and mental disorders. In 1895, he published 'Studies on Hysteria' with Josef Breuer, first proposing that psychological trauma could cause neurological symptoms. In 1900, Freud published 'The Interpretation of Dreams,' marking the formal birth of psychoanalytic theory. In 1902, he began regular meetings with like-minded physicians, gradually forming the psychoanalytic school. The First International Psychoanalytic Congress was held in Salzburg in 1908, and the International Psychoanalytic Association was founded in 1910 with Freud as president. During this period, Freud developed core theories about the unconscious, defense mechanisms, and psychosexual stages, and trained important followers including Carl Jung and Alfred Adler.

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 1933年，纳粹上台后开始焚烧弗洛伊德的著作，并禁止精神分析在德国传播。尽管弗洛伊德曾认为精神分析是'犹太科学'，但他最初不愿离开奥地利。1938年3月，纳粹吞并奥地利后，弗洛伊德的公寓遭到盖世太保搜查，女儿安娜被逮捕审讯。在国际友人（包括美国大使威廉·布利特和英国首相内维尔·张伯伦）的斡旋下，弗洛伊德一家最终获准离开奥地利。6月，弗洛伊德抵达伦敦，在梅克伦堡广场20号安家。尽管年事已高且身患口腔癌，他仍继续工作，完成了《摩西与一神教》等重要著作。1939年9月23日，弗洛伊德在伦敦逝世。
points.descriptionEn: After the Nazis came to power in 1933, Freud's books were burned and psychoanalysis was banned in Germany. Although Freud had once called psychoanalysis a 'Jewish science,' he initially resisted leaving Austria. Following the Nazi annexation of Austria in March 1938, Freud's apartment was searched by the Gestapo, and his daughter Anna was arrested and interrogated. Through the intervention of international friends including U.S. ambassador William Bullitt and British Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain, Freud's family was finally permitted to leave Austria. In June 1938, Freud arrived in London and settled at 20 Maresfield Gardens. Despite his advanced age and suffering from oral cancer, he continued working and completed important works like 'Moses and Monotheism.' Freud died in London on September 23, 1939.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1939年9月23日，弗洛伊德因口腔癌并发症在伦敦汉普斯特德家中逝世，享年83岁。在生命的最后时刻，他要求医生实施安乐死，以减轻痛苦。他的遗体被火化，骨灰安葬在伦敦哥德公墓。弗洛伊德的去世标志着精神分析学派的重大转折，但他的理论和思想继续影响着心理学、文学、艺术、哲学等多个领域。他的女儿安娜·弗洛伊德继承了他的事业，成为儿童精神分析的重要人物。今天，弗洛伊德被视为现代心理学的奠基人之一，他的理论虽然受到诸多批评和修正，但仍然是理解人类心理的重要框架。
points.descriptionEn: On September 23, 1939, Freud died at his home in Hampstead, London, at the age of 83, from complications of oral cancer. In his final moments, he requested euthanasia to end his suffering. His body was cremated, and his ashes were buried at Golders Green Crematorium. Freud's death marked a significant turning point for the psychoanalytic movement, but his theories and ideas continued to influence psychology, literature, art, philosophy, and other fields. His daughter Anna Freud carried on his work, becoming a major figure in child psychoanalysis. Today, Freud is regarded as one of the founders of modern psychology, and while his theories have faced numerous criticisms and revisions, they remain an important framework for understanding the human mind.

supporter.zh: 弗洛伊德被誉为现代心理学之父，他开创的精神分析理论彻底改变了人类对心理疾病的理解和治疗方法。他揭示了潜意识的重要性，提出了人格结构理论、防御机制和性心理发展阶段等概念，为后来的心理治疗奠定了基础。弗洛伊德强调童年经历对成人心理的决定性影响，这一观点至今仍被广泛接受。他的工作不仅推动了心理学的发展，还深刻影响了文学、艺术、哲学和社会学等多个领域，使心理学成为一门独立的科学学科。
supporter.en: Freud is hailed as the father of modern psychology, and his psychoanalytic theory revolutionized the understanding and treatment of mental disorders. He revealed the importance of the unconscious mind and developed concepts such as the structure of personality, defense mechanisms, and psychosexual stages, laying the foundation for later psychotherapeutic approaches. Freud's emphasis on the formative impact of childhood experiences on adult psychology remains widely accepted today. His work not only advanced psychology but also profoundly influenced literature, art, philosophy, and sociology, establishing psychology as an independent scientific discipline.

critic.zh: 弗洛伊德的理论受到多方面批评。首先，他的理论缺乏科学实证基础，许多概念难以通过实验验证。其次，他过度强调性因素在心理发展中的作用，忽视了社会文化因素。第三，他的样本主要局限于维也纳的中上层阶级女性，代表性不足。此外，弗洛伊德的某些观点如女性阴茎嫉妒理论被认为具有性别歧视色彩。他的治疗方法也受到质疑，如他对达帕的分析被批评为不专业。尽管如此，弗洛伊德的贡献在于他开创性地探索了人类心理的深层领域，尽管他的具体理论可能被修正或取代，但他提出的问题和方法论影响深远。
critic.en: Freud's theories have faced numerous criticisms. First, his work lacks scientific empirical validation, with many concepts difficult to test experimentally. Second, he overemphasized sexual factors in psychological development while neglecting sociocultural influences. Third, his sample was limited to upper-middle-class women in Vienna, lacking representativeness. Additionally, some of his views, such as the concept of penis envy in women, are considered sexist. His therapeutic methods have also been questioned, particularly his analysis of Dora, which was criticized as unprofessional. Nevertheless, Freud's contribution lies in his pioneering exploration of the depths of the human psyche, and while his specific theories may be modified or superseded, the questions he raised and his methodological approach have had a profound impact.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，弗洛伊德被塑造为一个复杂而矛盾的文化符号。一方面，他被视为科学革命者，敢于挑战传统观念，探索人类心理的未知领域；另一方面，他的理论和实践也反映了19世纪末维也纳的社会文化背景。弗洛伊德的思想已经超越了学术领域，成为大众文化的一部分，他的名字几乎成为'心理分析'的代名词。在当代心理学中，虽然弗洛伊德的具体理论大多已被修正或整合到更广泛的理论框架中，但他提出的关于潜意识、防御机制和早期经验重要性的概念仍然是心理学教育的基础部分。弗洛伊德的遗产不仅体现在学术领域，还体现在他对现代自我认知和自我理解方式的深刻影响上。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Freud has been shaped as a complex and contradictory cultural symbol. On one hand, he is viewed as a scientific revolutionary who challenged conventional wisdom and explored unknown territories of the human mind. On the other hand, his theories and practices reflect the sociocultural context of late 19th-century Vienna. Freud's ideas have transcended academia to become part of popular culture, with his name almost synonymous with 'psychoanalysis.' In contemporary psychology, while Freud's specific theories have largely been modified or integrated into broader theoretical frameworks, his concepts about the unconscious, defense mechanisms, and the importance of early experiences remain fundamental parts of psychological education. Freud's legacy is evident not only in academic circles but also in his profound influence on modern self-understanding and conceptions of the self.

self.zh: 有时，一个烟斗只是烟斗，但在大多数情况下，它远不止于此。
self.en: Sometimes a cigar is just a cigar, but most of the time it is much more than that.

others.zh: 弗洛伊德是那种罕见的人物，他不仅改变了他所研究的学科，还改变了西方文明的思维方式。
others.en: Freud is one of those rare individuals who not only changed the discipline he studied but also changed the way Western civilization thinks.
